name: agent-office
description: Watch Hermes, OpenCode, Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini sessions in a local pixel office, with reported usage and earned rewards.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Observes the configured server without running workspace code. Workspace-specific connection and startup settings require trust.

hermesPixelOffice.stateUrl.description: HTTP(S) URL of the Agent Office /state endpoint, reachable from this extension host. SSH/WSL/container users should run the observer in that environment. Embedded usernames/passwords are not supported.

hermesPixelOffice.openOnStartup.description: Open the floor when VS Code starts. Enabling this setting also opens it now.

hermesPixelOffice.showStatusBar.description: Show the Agent Office shortcut in the status bar.
